==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. (My name is Jet. Here is a general description of what I look like ""Man with dark-brown skin, full dark-brown beard, long dark-brown dreadlocks spilling from beneath a black hoodie over a “Dream Anime” graphic tee, black athletic pants with a white stripe, white sneakers, black cross-body belt bag, warm brown eyes."") This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) Alone I decided to create a world where everyone had to stay on the phone to survive. The world has pre-existing infrastructure for phones from the beginning that is naturally occurring. The implication there is that telephone poles seemingly can be grown, kind of like plants, but they can also be made artificially. Everyone is born with a phone that is literally a part of them, and is treated like an organ. When a person is born, their phone automatically starts in a call with their mother. It was very fascinating watching this world grow and seeing just how dangerous it was. Locations around the world with bad signal, became literal dead zones where people would die instantly. The desire to build out more infrastructure was there, but few people would dare risk approaching dead zones to even attempt to do so. This dream was creatively and mystically fulfilling, acting as both a god and an observer of my own new world.
